author: Accomplished-Shock47
body: Smalls Smash Club, San Clemente. Great smash burger and a nice selection of draft beer. If you have had a better smash burger I would love to know where.

author: grhymesforyou
body:
So…. The burger patty was good, the bun condensed into a soggy coaster. A beer is $9. The burger combo is like $14 but doesn’t include a beer. At $30 for a burger, fries and a drink with tax and tip.. that’s a lot. Also.. cheap brand ketchup packets for dining in? Are you fucking serious?

At $30 territory I’m at Riders Club or even better Mulligan’s burger and two Pacificos level and sorry but both are a better burger and beer at this price point.
